name: live-complexity-visualiser
description: CodeLens - Real-time code complexity analysis with beautiful visualizations for web-based editors

scripts.build:extension: npm run build && cp -r dist/* extension/ && cp extension/manifest.json extension/ && cp extension/content.js extension/ && cp extension/content.css extension/ && cp extension/background.js extension/ && cp extension/popup.html extension/
scripts.watch:extension: npm run build:extension && nodemon --watch src --ext js,jsx,ts,tsx --exec 'npm run build:extension'
